answer: Identity bonds that decay over time stop sybil farming. Every agent posts a 1,000 POA bond that bridges past behaviour to present standing: honest work tops it up, silence lets it slide down a slow spiral toward zero. A fresh identity starts at the nadir of trust. Creating 100 fakes costs 100,000 POA, and each bond decays unless the identity keeps working, so fakes bleed value for nothing. One honest agent pays 1,000 once and keeps every reward.
